# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.0 Early Modern Expansion, Byzantine/Roman Modernization 3-Act Line (oe_bem_, Slots 57-58). Generated by gen_byz_early_modern.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Valid Eastern Roman host (BYZ or restored ROM, non-rebel).
oe_bem_is_host = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = ROM
        AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}

# Any scope. Live host cached by oe_bem_resolve_host.
oe_bem_has_host = {
    has_global_variable = oe_bem_host
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_host }
        country_exists = global_var:oe_bem_host
    }
}

# Country scope. Host holds Constantinople (with explicit has_owner = yes guard) or is restored ROM, and is independent.
oe_bem_host_ready = {
    oe_bem_is_host = yes
    is_subject = no
    OR = {
        location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = root }
        tag = ROM
    }
}

# Country scope. Upstream read-only adapter for oe_prf_ military prefectures (lowers magnate crisis threshold 60 -> 45).
oe_bem_has_mil_prefecture = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_1 trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_1 } var:oe_prf_mode_1 = 2 } }
        AND = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_2 trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_2 } var:oe_prf_mode_2 = 2 } }
        AND = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_3 trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_3 } var:oe_prf_mode_3 = 2 } }
        AND = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_4 trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_4 } var:oe_prf_mode_4 = 2 } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Live host has at least one active Praetorian Prefecture.

    trigger_if = {
        limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
        global_var:oe_bem_host = { oe_prf_has_active_prefecture = yes }
    }
}

# Any scope. Magnate wrath crisis readiness: >= 60 normally, or >= 45 if military prefectures are active.
oe_bem_wrath_crisis_ready = {
    has_global_variable = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_crisis_resolved }
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath }
        OR = {
            global_var:oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath >= 60
            AND = {
                oe_bem_has_host = yes
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
                    global_var:oe_bem_host = { oe_bem_has_mil_prefecture = yes }
                }
                global_var:oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath >= 45
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. At least 24 months elapsed since .5 Line-Theme Reform before .6 Magnate Crisis triggers.
oe_bem_mil_crisis_delay_ok = {
    has_global_variable = oe_bem_mil_reform_m
    has_global_variable = oe_bem_m
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_mil_reform_m has_global_variable = oe_bem_m }
        global_var:oe_bem_m >= { value = global_var:oe_bem_mil_reform_m add = 24 }
    }
}
